en: Ācayagāmittika (The Triplet on Leading to Accumulation)

Dependent on a state that does not lead to accumulation … dependent on a state that does not lead to dispersal … dependent on a state that leads neither to accumulation nor to dispersal … (Abbreviated.
Under the root condition there are twenty-nine; under the object condition, twenty-four … under the result condition, nine … under the non-disappearance condition, twenty-nine.
